I couldn't confirm the first Sunday train for 6 December. The sources I found disagree and don't say which day they cover. Sunday first trains are usually later than weekday ones, so check National Rail or Northern's journey planner for that date. You can normally just turn up, because standard tickets don't need booking, though advance fares can be cheaper.

Sources: [Northern Railway](https://www.northernrailway.co.uk/trains/manchester-piccadilly-to-liverpool-lime-street), [live-departures.info](https://live-departures.info/rail/timetable/Liverpool-Lime-Street/Manchester-Piccadilly/)
